data.key: Implement School Focus Power ~ Sudden Speed
data.name: Sudden Speed [Transmutation]
data.description: As a swift action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus to grant yourself a burst of speed. This increases your land speed by 30 feet for 1 minute. This ability does not stack with itself.
